name: SurveySparrow
oneLiner: Survey and experience management platform known for chat-style conversational surveys, with NPS/CSAT tracking, AI text analysis, reputation management and closed-loop ticketing.
bestFor: Restaurants and hospitality groups that want friendly, mobile-first guest surveys sent by QR code, SMS, email or WhatsApp, recurring NPS or CSAT tracking and AI analysis of comments without an enterprise CX budget.

updates.text: Launched SparrowDesk, a separate AI-first customer support helpdesk that auto-resolves repetitive tickets and gives human agents an AI copilot.

features: Conversational, chat-like survey format alongside classic forms
Distribution by link, email, SMS, WhatsApp, QR code, web and in-app widgets, and offline kiosk apps
NPS, CSAT and CES surveys with recurring, automated sends
CogniVue AI text analysis that groups open-ended comments by theme and sentiment
AI survey creation and AI-assisted reporting
Reputation management for public reviews alongside survey feedback
Closed-loop workflows and tickets to follow up on unhappy responses
Integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack, Intercom and Zapier

pricing.text: Free plan with a small response limit. Paid survey plans billed annually are commonly listed as Basic $19/month, Starter $39/month, Business $79/month and Professional $249/month; Enterprise and the CX and 360 suites are quoted separately. 14-day free trial. Some 2026 sources list different tiers (Essentials $49, Business $99, Professional $499), so check the live pricing page.

notes: Pricing could not be confirmed on surveysparrow.com/pricing; figures come from third-party trackers and SurveySparrow's own blog, which conflict, so re-check before publishing. Dropped from current review: 'serving over 100,000 customers across 149 countries' and 'founded 2017, headquartered in Palo Alto' (not re-verified here), and the stray review-management glossary link listed as the website. CogniVue and AI Wings date from 2024 launches, not 2025-2026. A January 2026 partner webinar mentioned a new agentic AI module, but no press release was found, so it is left out of updates. No restaurant-only case study found; customers are casino resorts and a hospitality-adjacent nonprofit. Customer outcome figures (e.g. Pechanga +40% responses) are vendor-published.
